VYOM Edition 1 (2026–27) — Official Event Overview & Guidelines

VYOM Edition 1 (2026–27) is a premier National-Level Software Hackathon & Hardware–Software Project Expo organized by the Government College of Engineering, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (GECCS) in association with the Center of Excellence (CoE) – TSSIP and the Ankur Incubation Center Foundation (AICF).

Designed as a flagship two-pillar innovation festival, VYOM brings together India’s sharpest student builders across two distinct flagship events:

  1. Event 1: The 12-Hour National Software Hackathon — An intensive, high-stakes software development sprint across four specialized software domains.

  2. Event 2: The National Hardware & Software Project Expo — A dedicated exhibition showcase open to both Hardware and Software prototypes, working models, and engineering innovations.

Event at a Glance & Key Details

  • Dates: 2–3 January 2027 (Saturday–Sunday)

  • Venue: Government College of Engineering, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (GECCS Campus)

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹50,000+

  • Organized By: Government College of Engineering, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (GECCS)

  • In Association With: Center of Excellence (CoE) – TSSIP & Ankur Incubation Center Foundation (AICF)

  • Supporters: HackSlash, C-Cube, and Cybrotics

Team Eligibility & Formation Guidelines

  • Eligible Participants: Open to all undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and B.Sc. students enrolled in any recognized institute or university across India.

  • Team Size:

    • 12-Hour Software Hackathon: 3 to 5 members per team, including a designated Team Leader. Individual participation is not permitted.

    • Hardware & Software Project Expo: Up to 5 members maximum per team (individual or team entries of 1 to 5 members permitted).

  • Cross-College & Multidisciplinary Teams: Inter-college and multidisciplinary/inter-specialization teams (combining different engineering branches and academic years) are strongly encouraged and fully permitted.

Event 1: 12-Hour National Software Hackathon

Software Innovation Domains (4 Tracks)

Teams competing in the 12-Hour Software Hackathon can choose from any of the following four specialized domains:

  1. Healthcare & MedTech: Digital health registries, assistive clinical tools, and diagnostic data processing.

  2. AI, ML & Computational Intelligence: Neural architectures, computer vision, NLP, and predictive models.

  3. Agriculture & Smart Farming: Precision agronomy, soil monitoring, and yield prediction.

  4. Social Innovation & Rural Development: Community empowerment, rural utility access, and digital inclusion.

Hackathon Competition Process & Format

The hackathon follows a structured 3-round evaluation pipeline:

  • Round 1: PPT / Idea Submission (Online)

    • Registration Fee: 100% Free.

    • Format: Participants submit a structured PowerPoint presentation under their chosen Software domain.

    • Presentation Guidelines: Exactly 7 slides are required. Slide 1 must include basic team details, the team leader's name, the chosen problem statement, and domain. All slides must display the team's official logo. No rigid design template is mandated.

  • Round 2: Online Screening & Mentorship

    • Registration Fee: 100% Free.

    • Format: Submitted proposals and PPTs are evaluated by domain experts. Shortlisted teams qualify for the on-campus grand finale.

  • Round 3: On-Campus Grand Finale — 12-Hour Offline Software Hackathon

    • Venue: GECCS Campus, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.

    • Registration Fee: ₹999 per selected team (applicable only to teams shortlisted for Round 3; refreshments and dinner included).

    • Format: Intensive 12-hour offline coding sprint where teams architect, build, and deploy their software solutions live. Teams must demonstrate a fully working application, platform, or functional software system during final evaluation.

Event 2: National Hardware & Software Project Expo

  • Overview: A grand exhibition and live demonstration arena where student innovators present working Hardware prototypes and Software projects directly to industry experts, academic jury members, incubation leaders, and fellow builders.

  • Eligible Categories: Both Hardware and Software projects are permitted to exhibit.

  • Team Size: Maximum 5 members per project team.

  • Registration Fee: ₹249 per project (flat team registration fee; refreshments included).

  • Showcase Format: Teams set up dedicated exhibition booths on the GECCS Campus to present working prototypes, system architectures, live demos, and real-world engineering applications.

Key Rules & Policies

  • Cross-Event Participation: Teams are permitted to participate in both the 12-Hour Software Hackathon and the Hardware & Software Project Expo, provided the problem statements and projects submitted to each event are distinct.

  • AI & Development Tools: The use of AI software and coding assistants (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, etc.) is fully permitted for development, debugging, and ideation across all stages.

  • Pre-Existing Projects Policy: Pre-existing projects are welcomed in the Project Expo, provided teams explicitly highlight pre-existing components during evaluation and demonstrate newly added value or extensions built during the event timeline.

  • Intellectual Property (IP): Participating student teams retain full ownership and intellectual property rights over their codebases, designs, and prototypes, with fast-track pre-incubation support opportunities through AICF and CoE – TSSIP.

Organizing Committee & Contact

  • President: Ayush Suryawanshi

  • Director General (VYOM): Vedant Jha

  • Deputy Director General (VYOM): Piyush Chaudhari

  • Chief Administrator (VYOM): Ashutosh Ghodeswar

  • Secretary General (VYOM): Divya Mhaske

  • Official Support Email: vyom@geca.ac.in

  • Registration Portal: Register via the official Unstop platform or Google Form links provided in the official portal.
